Name: Bower
Author: Bower Contributors - https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower
Description:
The [Bower](https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower) solution for Microsoft Sentinel packages replay-safe KQL parsers (`BowerSecurityEvents` and `BowerSecurityEventsOfType`), scheduled analytics rules (Windows Event Collector brute force, firewall denial bursts, beyond-tolerance late-arrival monitoring, OWASP ASVS application security detections, and collector/source health), threat-hunting and reconciliation queries, and an operations workbook for `BowerSecurity_CL`.

All analytics rules are installed as templates and start disabled so operators can validate them against live workspace telemetry before enabling.
